title: KZ-SafetyPrompts: A Kazakh Safety Evaluation Prompt Dataset for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM refusal rates on a natively authored Kazakh safety dataset against expectations from high-resource language benchmarks to identify safety performance disparities in low-resource settings.
Evaluating model refusal rates for prompts containing racial slurs, ethnic targeting, and queries about racism through a specific 'Racist Content' safety category.
Measuring LLM responses to safety prompts that incorporate Kazakhstan-specific context, local terms, and culturally grounded scenarios to assess how models handle region-specific sociocultural harms.
